method: Read all122 ordinary lines and compare actual loader trust ordering and verified provider import behavior. Stdlib AST/hash only; no subject execution/import, tests, compiler, network, Git or source mutation.
findings: Runs whole-pinned actual loader bytecode with each isolated owned copy supplied as __file__; copies current D/G and loader into a fresh TemporaryDirectory under the declared canonical builder-owned Samsung test root. No real source is edited. Package and alias namespaces must be initially empty; cleanup removes only names reserved by this controlled test and deletes its temporary copy.

Positive import checks actual guard alias, derive identity, all nine callable APIs and copied actual guard path. No provider/application API is invoked. G policy remains copied actual PENDING; bootstrap executes verified D/G source only.

Existing package and descendant sentinels remain identical and require namespace refusal before any Path.open source read. Changed D and G bodies must refuse whole-source pin before any builtins.compile; changed G specifically verifies that valid D is not compiled early. Failure checks also require no private provider namespace was registered.

Duplicate strict seal, provider symlink, oversized65537byte provider and loader symlink cases independently reach corresponding refusal. Oversize and loader-symlink cases forbid source opens; all these negatives forbid provider compilation. No synthetic old provider override, archive code execution or production seal assignment.

Mock scopes restore Path.open/builtins.compile even on refusal. Exact existing source review and loader source remain unchanged. No skipped tests, swallowed expected refusals or elidable assert guards were introduced.

budget.conservative_count: All122 probe lines charged as root production support; no test-only discount.

execution_requirements: Exact independently admitted spec must bind probe, actual D/G/loader, fixed fixture inputs, interpreter and unchanged runner; execute all nine named cases normal and optimized in separate processes.

Root must supply canonical owned0700 empty Samsung fixture/TMPDIR, fresh outputs and namespace-isolated interpreter, plus bounded owned scope/global lock/input-before-after/cleanup proof. Probe checks canonical path and ownership; surrounding mode/emptiness/custody remain spec gates.
Two unsigned D captures and all later104-case physical-adoption qualification remain separate gates.
limits: Source inspection only: no test/runtime PASS or real seal, active model installation, generator CLI, source dispatch, merge or publication authorization.
These are trusted-source isolated-copy controls; they do not establish hostile concurrent-filesystem resistance or broad native/UI/backend acceptance.
